name: The rail, the header tabs and the settings fields all render in Spanish

actions.comment: The three surfaces the operator reported: left rail groups, header tabs, and the core settings field labels. leakedEnglish must be empty.
actions.value: const rail=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar .nav-label')].map(n=>n.textContent.trim()); const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tabrail-tab')].map(n=>n.textContent.trim()); const fields=[...document.querySelectorAll('.fld-lang-label, .st-fld-label, label')].map(n=>n.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,12); const body=document.body.innerText; JSON.stringify({ rail, tabs, groupChip: document.querySelector('.header-nav-group')?.textContent?.trim(), search: document.querySelector('.search-label')?.textContent?.trim(), leakedEnglish: ['Home','Work','Wellness','Leisure','Tools','Settings','Extensions','Notifications','Timezone','Default language','Search'].filter(s=>body.includes(s)) })

name: Switching the shell back to English restores the English labels
